name: rust-subagent-smoke
description: Small Rust tasks that should benefit from one read-only explore subagent handoff before editing.

tasks.prompt: Use the explore subagent first to inspect src/features.rs, then refactor feature_enabled by extracting the team-tier feature predicate into a small private helper named team_feature_enabled. Preserve behavior and run cargo test.

Use the explore subagent first to inspect src/report.rs, then refactor report_status by extracting the score bucket decision into a small private helper named score_bucket. Preserve behavior and run cargo test.
